boundary: These records describe evidence that must be produced by real people, real devices, an authorised production site or an external accreditor. CI, synthetic data, modelled learners, contract tests and generated artifacts cannot populate validation metadata or promote these rows to validated.

requiredChecks: Verify the production package carries the intended trusted code-signing identity and an intact signature chain
Install, launch, close and uninstall on a real supported Windows machine
Verify Windows reputation and warning behavior, including SmartScreen where applicable
Verify local persistence, offline launch and packaged asset integrity on the installed build
Retain release-specific hashes and reviewer evidence without storing secrets or personal identifiers
Review all core lesson claims for injection-moulding technical correctness and safe scope
Review specialist optional learning content and evidence boundaries
Review assessment blueprint and keyed-answer semantics against the taught curriculum
Record material corrections, unresolved disagreements and reviewer authority
Do not infer SME approval from automated source, schema or citation checks
Use outcomes from real learners rather than synthetic or modelled learner records
Predefine the learning-outcome measures, comparison method and minimum usable sample
Preserve privacy and exclude raw assessment text or unnecessary personal identifiers
Separate observed learning outcomes from engagement, completion and QA metrics
Retain limitations and uncertainty with the release-specific evidence
Use an explicitly authorised production site and authorised site reviewer
Validate representative local process-data intake and advisory workflows with site-controlled data
Confirm recommendations remain decision support and do not automatically control machinery
Record site-specific limitations, acceptance criteria and unresolved risks
Retain only privacy-safe evidence approved for repository or release governance use
Identify the external accrediting body and exact programme or product scope
Retain the accreditor-issued award, approval or register reference
Bind the award to the applicable content/version and validity period
Do not promote internal readiness checks into an accreditation claim
Record any conditions, exclusions or renewal requirements
